basic_details.job_title: ICAR-IARI Young Professional II (Genetics) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Division of Genetics, ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute, New Delhi, is hiring two Young Professional-II (YP-II) on a short-term, purely contract basis under the Collaborative Outstation Research Centre (CORC) of ICAR-IARI: one at Rakhra, Punjab and one at Mandasaur, M.P. The pay is ₹42,000 per month (fixed) with no HRA. A postgraduate degree in Genetics, Plant Breeding, Genetics & Plant Breeding, Biotechnology or Molecular Biology and Biotechnology is essential. Applications are emailed to [email protected] by 1 December 2026, and the notice is dated 5 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Get the application form (Annexure-I) and the declaration (Annexure-II). Both are in the notice, and the application form and detailed terms and conditions may be downloaded from https://iari.res.in/bms/announcements/jobs.php
Write the interview mode preference, Offline or Online, at the top of the application.
In the form, give the post applied for as YP-II (Rakhra/Mandsaur), as printed in Annexure-I, and paste a recent self-attested passport-size photograph.
Fill in the academic and professional qualifications, the experience (supported by certificates issued by the concerned employers), additional professional training and awards, if any.
Email the scanned application (Annexure-I), bio-data, photo, self-attested certificates and declaration (Annexure-II) to [email protected] by 01.12.2026.
The notice states that all applications received after the mentioned time limit will stand rejected. The notice does not print an email subject line.
Experience certificates issued by concerned employers
No Objection Certificate, if currently employed
important_instructions: The positions are purely on temporary basis. These contract positions do not constitute a regular job offer. A signed Declaration of Secrecy and Non-Disclosure Agreement is mandatory before joining. Selected candidates shall submit a Medical Fitness Certificate from an MBBS doctor at their own cost. If a candidate is found to have submitted false claims at a later stage, the candidature will be summarily rejected and no correspondence will be entertained. Engagement of YP-I/YP-II is regulated as per regulations/procedures specified by ICAR from time to time.

content_sections.heading: About ICAR-IARI Division of Genetics
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Division of Genetics of the ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute, New Delhi. The two posts are for technical manpower at the Collaborative Outstation Research Centre (CORC) of ICAR-IARI, at Rakhra in Punjab and Mandasaur in Madhya Pradesh.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The total is 2 posts. The notice prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The application form asks currently employed applicants to give full employer details and produce a No Objection Certificate. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: Postgraduate degree in Genetics / Plant Breeding / Genetics & Plant Breeding / Biotechnology / Molecular Biology and Biotechnology
rows.desirable: Experience in field/lab experimentations, Molecular Marker Techniques, Data Analysis, Documentation, compilation of reports

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated monthly emolument is Rs. 42,000/- for YP-II. No House Rent Allowance (HRA) or other allowance is payable to YPs. Income tax or any other tax liable to be deducted is deducted as per prevailing rules. Initial engagement is for one year, extendable up to a maximum of three years (1+1+1), subject to the requirement of the services of YP in the organization and satisfactory performance. Domestic tour TA/DA limits apply: AC-2 Tier / AC Chair Car for YP-II and DA @ Rs. 1500/-day. Leave: 8 days casual leave and 2 restricted holidays per calendar year. Female YPs are entitled to maternity leave. Working hours match regular employees. Unauthorized absence of 8 continuous days leads to automatic termination.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR-IARI Young Professional-II
content_sections.text: Get the application form (Annexure-I) and the declaration (Annexure-II). Both are in the notice, and the application form and detailed terms and conditions may be downloaded from https://iari.res.in/bms/announcements/jobs.php Write the interview mode preference, Offline or Online, at the top of the application. In the form, give the post applied for as YP-II (Rakhra/Mandsaur), as printed in Annexure-I, and paste a recent self-attested passport-size photograph. Fill in the academic and professional qualifications, the experience (supported by certificates issued by the concerned employers), additional professional training and awards, if any. Email the scanned application (Annexure-I), bio-data, photo, self-attested certificates and declaration (Annexure-II) to [email protected] by 01.12.2026. The notice states that all applications received after the mentioned time limit will stand rejected. The notice does not print an email subject line. Scanned application (Annexure-I) Bio-data Photo Self-attested certificates Declaration (Annexure-II) Experience certificates issued by concerned employers No Objection Certificate, if currently employed

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection has two stages. First, the applications received are screened and shortlisted based on qualifying academic performance as per assessment criteria. Then the shortlisted candidates are selected through an interview, described as a panel interview, conducted in Hybrid Mode. Candidates indicate Offline or Online as their preferred interview mode at the top of the application. The notice gives no interview date or venue, and no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the Exam/Interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many Young Professional-II posts is ICAR-IARI recruiting?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts in total: 1 at Rakhra, Punjab and 1 at Mandasaur, M.P.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for ICAR-IARI YP-II?
faq.answer: The application must be emailed by 01.12.2026, and applications received after the time limit stand rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for Young Professional-II?
faq.answer: A postgraduate degree in Genetics, Plant Breeding, Genetics & Plant Breeding, Biotechnology or Molecular Biology and Biotechnology is essential. Experience in field/lab experimentations, Molecular Marker Techniques, Data Analysis, Documentation and compilation of reports is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ICAR-IARI YP-II?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21-45 Years, with relaxation as per rules. Age is reckoned from the date of advertisement.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of Young Professional-II at ICAR-IARI?
faq.answer: The pay is ₹42,000/month (Fixed). No HRA or other allowance is payable.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for ICAR-IARI Young Professional-II?
faq.answer: Email the scanned application (Annexure-I), bio-data, photo, self-attested certificates and declaration (Annexure-II) to [email protected] by 01.12.2026.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for ICAR-IARI YP-II?
faq.answer: Applications are screened and shortlisted based on qualifying academic performance. Shortlisted candidates are selected through a panel interview in Hybrid Mode.

faq.question: Q8. Is the ICAR-IARI Young Professional-II job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are short-term, purely contract and temporary, with an initial engagement of one year, extendable up to a maximum of three years (1+1+1). They do not constitute a regular job offer.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the Exam/Interview.
